notes.title: Update 4 - Survival
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7zGxv7rMBwYpOjPx2c/giphy.gif[/img]
New mode and winter map.

Survive in the cold, playing the minesweeper, get all the game awards, moving lower into the bowels of the earth.

Chickens can't stand cold and freeze. They will still prevent you from playing, but now they can be easily rolled back to the far corner.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/62e1dfnrYc5uBtP4JZ/giphy.gif[/img]

Starting from round 2, the temperature will start to fall -  you can follow the percentage of cold in the left corner of your screen. When the cold reaches 50% - your speed will decrease by 2 times. When it comes to 90 or more - 4 times. The only way to avoid it - is playing. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33271840/ec6958a075994f05e0cb9425f9c9dcb6d6df3a78.png[/img]
Each opening of the cell triggers warmer for 4 seconds, after which it will become colder again if you do not open the cells. 
Also opening a cell gives you survival points - from 1 to 10 depending on the cold. The higher the percentage of cold - the less survival points you get. These survival points will go to the leaderboard when you finish surviving (defeat).

[h1]Rotation awards[/h1]

Each successful opening of the field no longer ends the game, but gives you a reward depending on the round. The rotation of awards on the shooting range is as follows: 1-1-1-2-3-4, i.e. from 1-3 round - awards fall from tier 1, 4 round - tier 2, 5 round - tier 3, 6 round - tier 4. Then again, i.e. Round 7 is again tier 1, and round 12 is tier 4. This will be repeated until you lose, which means the end of survival. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33271840/0b4cc980833593a5ea3bcbd33c42bbbc417c5025.png[/img]

On the right you can see a list of the awards received during the game match and the time spent on each round.
The current tier will be displayed on the screen so that you don't get confused.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33271840/ca3ce5e43f1bc86a1d41879b3b6fa9411979a634.png[/img]

[h1]Field rotation[/h1]
In survival, you do not choose the size of the field and the number of bombs, they change themselves depending on the round.
 [list]
[*] from 1-3 the field is similar to the easy mode 9x9
[*] the 4th round is a new 12x12 field with 16 bombs
[*] 5-6 rounds are the field similar to the medium 16x16 mode with 30 bombs
[/list]
 
And so in a circle until you lose.

[h1]Entertainment[/h1]
After finishing survival there can be too many frozen chickens, and the only way to get rid of them is to cut in the new device - Chicken Slicer. 
Just push the chicken closer to it and the slicer will cut it into pieces.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1BhGf7HUuYlJk9mClh/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Achievement[/h1]
3 new achievements are timed to the mode, which will allow you to feel the whole new mode.
- Survivor
- Chicken Lunch
- Frozen rabbit
